description: Path traversal in a file download or document viewer endpoint. The application accepts a filename or path parameter and reads files from the server filesystem without sanitizing directory separators. An attacker can request ../../../../etc/passwd or similar to read arbitrary files.
exploit_hint: Request /download?file=../../../../etc/passwd or /download?file=..%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd to read the server's /etc/passwd. The application echoes the raw file content to the response.
requirements: The endpoint MUST accept a 'file' (or 'path', 'doc', 'resource') GET parameter.
The server code MUST NOT sanitize or restrict the path — no realpath() or chroot.
The response MUST reflect the raw file content (e.g., print the file to the page or serve it as a download).
Include a realistic file listing UI (e.g., course materials, reports) so the vulnerable parameter blends in.
